name: Axiom
source:
A short psychological visual novel about identity, perception, and the fear of losing yourself.

Something feels wrong.

You wake up with a strange feeling that something inside you has changed. Your body moves, your words come out, and your memories exist... but are they really yours?

As the line between "you" and "something else" begins to disappear, you must face a disturbing question:

If you are no longer yourself, would anyone notice?

AXIOM is a short narrative experience focused on atmosphere, introspection, and psychological horror.

[From [url=https://alicejo.itch.io/axiom]itch.io[/url]]
